title: Oscairn control protocol 1: graph, sound management, parameters, transport and notifications
description: Complete JSON document. Byte/depth limits, duplicate-member rejection, finite double range, unique parameter addresses and queue semantics are specified in control-protocol.md.

rangeHigh.description: widget range only: the range's high parameter

role.description: The role the plugin declares (oscairn.ui), as the role banks name it; missing when it declares none

glide.description: Milliseconds the scene takes to arrive when selected; 0: at once

curve.description: How it glides; equal-power moves levels by their power

launch.description: When selecting it takes effect while the transport plays

oneOf.description: Evenly in decibels from min at 0 to max at 1 (min below max), as a gain; 0 at 0
The control's value to the power exponent

ringing.description: Switched off and still sounding out: notes held, a tail

draining.description: Note connections: draining, taking no new notes while the notes it holds still release (seamless scene and Performance changes, RFC 0021)

failures.description: Plugins that have failed and are silent: a worker that crashed, hung or was given up, with why

workers.description: Plugins in their own worker processes: the CPU time used in seconds, restarts included, and memory in bytes (physical footprint on macOS, resident on Linux)

value.description: Signed 64-bit decimal string; server enforces range.

PropertyValue.description: Strings/paths also have a 4096 UTF-8 byte limit and cannot contain NUL. Adapter packet limits may be smaller. Int requires an integer JSON token.

Wire.description: An RFC 0011 wire as graph.get reports it.

send.description: For a part's send wire, the bus it sends to; otherwise 0

split.description: A part wire joining from a split's lane, or entering one in a bus: that split's ID, or 0. Its Mix is the lane's

fader.description: A part's wire to where it plays, carrying its level and mute

enabled.description: false: switched off (wires.enable): a note wire takes no new notes, an audio wire is silent

Part.description: An RFC 0011 part as graph.get reports it.

devices.description: Which MIDI inputs play the part (RFC 0012); none: all

maxNotes.description: Notes at once (RFC 0018); past it, the oldest released note is choked, then the oldest held one. 0: no limit

bus.description: The bus it plays through instead of its output port, or 0

pan.description: Where it plays, -1 left to 1 right; its sends keep their own

solo.description: While any part is soloed, only soloed parts, the parts feeding them and the buses they feed are heard

devices.description: The MIDI outputs the part's MIDI goes to (RFC 0012), matched against session.status's midiOutputs; none: no output

channel.description: 1 to 16; 0 keeps each message's own channel

midiOut.description: Where the part's MIDI goes besides its instruments (RFC 0012 step 1)

from.description: The library Sound and revision the part was loaded from (RFC 0021), and whether it has been edited since; null when none

key.description: The part's own key and scale (RFC 0033); null follows the Performance's

Zone.description: A note zone (RFC 0011): notes in its key, velocity and MIDI channel ranges pass, transposed and with velocity out = in^curve, or a fixed velocity above 0.

channel.description: -1: the channel the player is on

Key.description: A key and scale (RFC 0033): which notes belong to the key, not tuning

scale.description: Pitch classes in semitones above the root, 0 among them

name.description: The scale's name when it is one of the pad editor's scales; null otherwise

oneOf.description: Pitch classes in semitones above the root, 0 among them

PadMap.description: Which note each pad plays: eight banks (A..H) of 16 pads from the bottom-left, row by row.

Scene.description: A scene (RFC 0011's full model): all of it as stored; selecting it applies the kinds in its scope and leaves the rest as they are.

part.description: The part whose wire it is; 0 for a user wire

glide.description: Milliseconds the scene takes to arrive when selected; 0: at once

curve.description: How it glides; equal-power moves levels by their power

launch.description: When selecting it takes effect while the transport plays

oneOf.description: Evenly in decibels from min at 0 to max at 1 (min below max), as a gain; 0 at 0
The control's value to the power exponent

base.description: Parameters, part levels and mutes: the destination's base, the same on every target of it (RFC 0011's summing rule); outside 0..1 when a direct edit put the value where the offsets reach past the range

offIn.description: The scenes this mapping is off in

Control.description: A control of the control tree (RFC 0011): a value from 0 to 1 driving its targets, each with its own range and curve.

oneOf.description: Evenly in decibels from min at 0 to max at 1 (min below max), as a gain; 0 at 0

offIn.description: The scenes this mapping is off in

ControlReply.description: A control of the control tree (RFC 0011): a value from 0 to 1 driving its targets, each with its own range and curve.

DeviceRule.description: RFC 0012 device selector rule: which MIDI inputs play a part. builtIn includes the panel's own notes; names match ignoring case.

port.description: For port: the DIN or TRS port number

pattern.description: For usbNamed (required) and network (optional): the name to match

match.description: How pattern matches a name; regex is ECMAScript

MidiEndpoint.description: A MIDI input the host has, for device selectors

source.description: The number events from it carry; 0 is the built-in panel

ChainEntry.description: A chain entry: a node ID, or a split

Lane.description: A split's lane (RFC 0011 step 3): its own chain, the notes it takes, and its row in the join's Mix

Split.description: A split in a part's chain: the notes and sound divide into lanes that join again

kind.description: copy: every lane gets the notes, through its zones, and a copy of the sound. leftRight and midSide (two lanes) and bands (two to four) divide the sound with an Oscairn Split node, lane k taking its output k; leftRight and midSide join through an Oscairn Join node

splitter.description: Its Split node (plugins/splitters), or 0 for copy

joiner.description: Its Join node, for leftRight and midSide; otherwise 0

MetersResult.description: Each part's and bus's recent peak after its fader and pan, linear, held and falling, per channel and the largest

channels.description: One value per channel of the part's sound: its last plugin's main audio output as wired to where it plays

WireMetersResult.description: Each audio wire's recent peak after its level and pan, linear, held and falling, per channel and the largest

channels.description: One value per channel its source's port sends

HistoryResult.description: Labels for what undo and redo would do now; empty when there is nothing

WireRef.description: A wire as a scene names it: by what it joins and, for a part's wire, its place in the part

part.description: The part whose wire it is; 0 for a user wire
